C08-M10-L05-F1.title: Mapping Banyan observations to ATT&CK tactics with confidence
C08-M10-L05-F1.caption: Candidate tactics are hypotheses, not findings. No technique IDs are listed; verify any citation against the current ATT&CK version.
C08-M10-L05-F1.alt: A table with four columns: observation, candidate tactic, confidence and benign alternative. The WS-104 download followed by an Office child process maps to Execution at moderate confidence, with a routine helper process as the alternative. Repeated requests to cdn-telemetry-sync.example map to Command and Control at low confidence, pending a prevalence check. The large transfer maps to Exfiltration at moderate confidence with content unknown. Eight failed VPN identities map to Credential Access at moderate confidence, with a shared egress address as the alternative. A final row shows that a link between gopal and WS-104 is unsupported because no shared entity exists.
